We focus on the factual knowledge probing task, where a fact is represented as a subject-relation-object triple ⟨s i , r i , o i ⟩ and expressed in natural language prompts. Given a prompt constructed from the subject s i and relation r i , LMs are expected to predict the object o i .
outputs: generated answer strings (e.g., Ottawa) for factual prompts
